interface.name: openkaryon_window_snapshot_v1

description.summary: visible window bounds for the desktop screenshot picker

interface.description: snapshot returns visible, mapped toplevel rectangles in global logical coordinates, topmost first, followed by done. Decorations are included, shadows and resize hitboxes are excluded. Minimized windows and windows on hidden workspaces are omitted. A snapshot is not a live subscription. No data is returned while the session is locked. Sandboxed clients must not be offered this private desktop interface. Captures use the visible screen pixels: any occluding windows remain in the resulting rectangle.

arg.name: available
arg.summary: zero if the session is locked
